SMART_ROOT 0
  foo => foo (bar|Baz|<n>)
  say => say <msg>
  give => give <target> <item> [<count>]
  tp => tp <x> <y> <z>
  flag => flag <v>
  big => big <n>
  alias => alias -> foo
  run => run ...
  each => each ...
  as => as <n> ...
  whoami => whoami
  opt => opt [x|y]
  multi => multi (a|b|c)
  fail => fail
  pick => pick <c>
  pick2 => pick2 (<c>|alpha|Alphabet|beta)
SMART foo 0
  bar => bar
  Baz => Baz
  n => <n> [<w>]
SMART admin 0
  stop => stop
SMART opt 0
  x => [x]
  y => [y]

  a => a
  b => b
  c => c

SMART pick2 0
  c => <c>

  Alphabet => Alphabet
  beta => beta
SMART_ROOT 3
  foo => foo (bar|Baz|<n>)
  say => say <msg>
  give => give <target> <item> [<count>]
  admin => admin (stop|op)
  tp => tp <x> <y> <z>
  flag => flag <v>
  big => big <n>
  alias => alias -> foo
  run => run ...
  each => each ...
  as => as <n> ...
  whoami => whoami
  opt => opt [x|y]
  multi => multi (a|b|c)
  fail => fail
  pick => pick <c>
  pick2 => pick2 (<c>|alpha|Alphabet|beta)
SMART foo 3
  bar => bar
  Baz => Baz
  n => <n> [<w>]
SMART admin 3
  stop => stop
  op => op
SMART opt 3
  x => [x]
  y => [y]
SMART multi 3
  a => a
  b => b
  c => c
SMART give 3
  target => <target> <item> [<count>]
SMART pick2 3
  c => <c>
  alpha => alpha
  Alphabet => Alphabet
  beta => beta
NODE foo => <literal foo> | foo | [foo] | foo
NODE foo n => <argument n:integer(0, 100)> | <n> | [0, 123, -123] | foo n
NODE foo n w => <argument w:string()> | <w> | [word, words_with_underscores] | foo n w
NODE give target item count => <argument count:integer(1)> | <count> | [0, 123, -123] | give target item count
NODE tp x => <argument x:double(-10.0, 10.0)> | <x> | [0, 1.2, .5, -1, -.5, -1234.56] | tp x
NODE tp x y z => <argument z:float(0.0, 5.0)> | <z> | [0, 1.2, .5, -1, -.5, -1234.56] | tp x y z
NODE flag v => <argument v:BoolArgumentType> | <v> | [true, false] | flag v
NODE big n => <argument n:longArg(0, 1000)> | <n> | [0, 123, -123] | big n
NODE say msg => <argument msg:string()> | <msg> | [word, words with spaces, "and symbols"] | say msg
NODE alias => <literal alias> | alias | [alias] | alias
NODE nope => null
NODE foo nope => null
PATH_REDIRECT foo
